interpretation.absolute_four_class_was_low_because: Between-subject normoxia range exceeds mean within-subject hypoxia delta; absolute features mix identity with condition.
interpretation.delta_is_not_cheating: Subject baseline uses only that subject's normoxia sample. LOSO still removes the entire subject from training.
remaining_limits: Four-class still confuses reoxygenation states (biology overlaps).
Five RNA modules only; not multi-modal.
n=15 subjects; point estimates are noisy.
Legacy primary metrics include the supplied normoxia references; query_only excludes them from scoring.
Delta normoxia vectors equal zero by construction; normoxia recall is not independent diagnostic accuracy.

method.delta_definition: For each subject, subtract that subject's normoxia domain vector from each condition vector. Held-out normoxia is required as a test-time covariate, never used to fit training parameters.
method.preprocessing: fit centers/scales on development subjects independently in each fold

primary_metrics_scope: Legacy baseline-inclusive scores; use query_primary_metrics for non-reference queries
